gloss: debtor; person who owes a debt

definitions.gloss: debtor; person who owes a debt
definitions.explanation: A person or entity that owes money or has a financial obligation to another party. A formal legal and financial term.

examples.japanese: {債務者|さいむしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{債務者|さいむしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{守|まも}られている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: The rights of debtors are protected by law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{多重|たじゅう}→多重：19772_tajuu⟧{債務者|さいむしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救済|きゅうさい}→救済：12928_kyuusai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: A system was established to help people with multiple debts.

notes:
A formal legal and financial term. The opposite of ⟦{債権者|さいけんしゃ}→債権者：22802_saikensha⟧ (creditor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{多重|たじゅう}→多重：19772_tajuu⟧{債務者|さいむしゃ}: person with multiple debts
- {債務者|さいむしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: debtor's obligation
- {債務者|さいむしゃ}⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧: debtor protection
- {連帯|れんたい}{債務者|さいむしゃ}: joint debtor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{債権者|さいけんしゃ}→債権者：22802_saikensha⟧: creditor — the person or entity owed money

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧: debt, obligation
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧: debt, loan — more everyday term
- ⟦{負債|ふさい}→負債：14950_fusai⟧: liability, debt — used in accounting

FORMS:
⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧ (debt, obligation) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person)
